title: Chart
description: Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view.
when: Compare categories (BarChart), show change over time (LineChart), parts of a whole with ≤ 5 parts (DonutChart), a trend next to a KPI (Sparkline).

instead.need: Exact values to compare and sort

instead.use: two charts, never a second y axis

a11y: Each chart is role="img" with a label; focus it and use ←/→ (Home / End) to read every index in the tooltip; “Xem bảng” switches to a table with all values.
Colour is never the only channel: legend (2+ series), tooltip labels and the table view carry identity; text stays in text tokens.
notes: Keep a series' colour fixed per entity (color: slot) so a filter never repaints the others.
Put the visible title in the card around the chart; label is the accessible name.
